sentences.text: Prej tetë vitesh Dritani punonte në një kompani ndërtimi.
sentences.english: For eight years Dritan had been working in a construction company.

sentences.text: Çdo mëngjes ngrihej në orën gjashtë dhe çdo mbrëmje kthehej i lodhur, por i lumtur.
sentences.english: Every morning he got up at six and every evening he came back tired, but happy.

sentences.text: Kishte ndërtuar shtëpi, shkolla dhe një urë të vogël mbi një përrua.
sentences.english: He had built houses, schools and a small bridge over a stream.

sentences.text: Të hënën Dritani u kthye nga puna në mesditë, dhe kjo nuk kishte ndodhur kurrë më parë.
sentences.english: On Monday Dritan came back from work at midday, and this had never happened before.

sentences.text: Mira ishte në kuzhinë dhe po përgatiste drekën kur e dëgjoi derën.
sentences.english: Mira was in the kitchen preparing lunch when she heard the door.

sentences.text: — Dritan, çfarë ka ndodhur? — e pyeti ajo.
sentences.english: "Dritan, what has happened?" she asked him.

sentences.text: Ai nuk u përgjigj.
sentences.english: He did not answer.

sentences.text: E la xhaketën mbi karrige, u ul në tavolinë dhe e vuri kokën në duar.
sentences.english: He left his jacket on a chair, sat down at the table and put his head in his hands.

sentences.text: — Kompania humbi kontratën e madhe, — tha ai më në fund.
sentences.english: "The company lost the big contract," he said at last.

sentences.text: — Shefi na tha se nuk ka më punë për të gjithë ne.
sentences.english: "The boss told us that there is no more work for all of us."

sentences.text: — Sa punëtorë mbetën? — pyeti Mira.
sentences.english: "How many workers stayed?" asked Mira.

sentences.text: — Njëzet vetë. Unë nuk jam mes tyre.
sentences.english: "Twenty people. I am not among them."

sentences.text: Mira u ul pranë tij dhe nuk tha asgjë për një moment.
sentences.english: Mira sat down beside him and said nothing for a moment.

sentences.text: Pastaj i vuri dorën mbi dorë.
sentences.english: Then she put her hand on his hand.

sentences.text: — Dëgjo, — tha ajo.
sentences.english: "Listen," she said.

sentences.text: — Ne kemi disa kursime, dhe unë kam pagën time si mësuese.
sentences.english: "We have some savings, and I have my pay as a teacher."

sentences.text: — Nuk do të kemi gjithçka që kemi pasur, por do të kemi bukë.
sentences.english: "We will not have everything we have had, but we will have bread."

sentences.text: — Po borxhi i makinës? — pyeti Dritani.
sentences.english: "And the debt for the car?" asked Dritan.

sentences.text: — Nëse nuk gjen punë deri në pranverë, do ta shesim makinën, — tha Mira.
sentences.english: "If you do not find work by spring, we will sell the car," said Mira.

sentences.text: — Është vetëm një makinë.
sentences.english: "It is only a car."

sentences.text: — Ti thoshe gjithmonë se do të ishe njeriu që mban familjen, — tha ajo me zë të ulët.
sentences.english: 'You always said that you would be the man who supports the family,' she said in a low voice.

sentences.text: — Por një familje nuk mbahet nga një njeri i vetëm.
sentences.english: "But a family is not supported by one person alone."

sentences.text: Në atë kohë erdhën nga shkolla Gjergji dhe Elira.
sentences.english: At that moment Gjergj and Elira came home from school.

sentences.text: — Baba, pse je në shtëpi? — pyeti Elira.
sentences.english: "Father, why are you at home?" asked Elira.

sentences.text: Dritani e shikoi Mirën.
sentences.english: Dritan looked at Mira.

sentences.text: — Sepse sot kisha një ditë të gjatë dhe të vështirë, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Because today I had a long and difficult day," he said.

sentences.text: Gjergji, që ishte njëmbëdhjetë vjeç, nuk e besoi.
sentences.english: Gjergj, who was eleven years old, did not believe him.

sentences.text: Ai e ndjeu që prindërit e tij nuk i thoshin gjithçka, por nuk pyeti asgjë.
sentences.english: He felt that his parents were not telling them everything, but he did not ask anything.

sentences.text: Në vend të kësaj, e mori Elirën për dore dhe e çoi në dhomë për të luajtur.
sentences.english: Instead, he took Elira by the hand and led her to the room to play.

sentences.text: Atë natë Dritani nuk fjeti.
sentences.english: That night Dritan did not sleep.

sentences.text: Ai qëndroi te dritarja dhe e shikoi qytetin.
sentences.english: He stayed by the window and looked at the city.

sentences.text: Kujtoi ditët kur kishte menduar se çdo gjë që kishte vinte nga forca e tij.
sentences.english: He remembered the days when he had thought that everything he had came from his own strength.

sentences.text: Tani e dinte se kishte gabuar.
sentences.english: Now he knew that he had been wrong.

sentences.text: Atë natë ai bëri një listë me atë që kishin: kursimet, borxhin e makinës dhe pagën e Mirës.
sentences.english: That night he made a list of what they had: the savings, the debt for the car and Mira's pay.

sentences.text: Mira erdhi pa folur dhe qëndroi pranë tij.
sentences.english: Mira came without speaking and stood beside him.

sentences.text: — Do të lutemi bashkë? — pyeti ajo.
sentences.english: "Shall we pray together?" she asked.

sentences.text: — Nuk e di se çfarë të them, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "I do not know what to say," he said.

sentences.text: — Nuk duhet të thuash shumë, — u përgjigj Mira.
sentences.english: "You do not have to say much," Mira answered.

sentences.text: — Thuaj vetëm që ke frikë.
sentences.english: 'Just say that you are afraid.'

sentences.text: Të martën në mëngjes Sami erdhi te dera e tyre.
sentences.english: On Tuesday morning Sam came to their door.

sentences.text: Mbante një çantë të madhe në dorë.
sentences.english: He had a big bag in his hand.

sentences.text: — Gjyshja Drita dërgoi bukë, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Grandmother Drita sent bread," he said.

sentences.text: — Më tha se dëgjoi diçka në treg dhe se ju pret të dielën për darkë.
sentences.english: "She told me that she had heard something at the market and that she expects you on Sunday for dinner."

sentences.text: Dritani e mori çantën dhe për herë të parë atë ditë buzëqeshi.
sentences.english: Dritan took the bag and for the first time that day he smiled.
